transcript: Speaker A: These are vegetables. I am cutting vegetables. Cutting means making small pieces. I use a knife. I am frying eggs. Frying means cooking in hot oil. I use a pan. I am boiling water. Boiling means very hot water. The water is bubbling. I am stirring the soup. Stirring means moving in a circle. I use a spoon. I am serving the food. Serving means giving food to someone. I put food on the table. Come, eat! I am washing the dishes. Washing means cleaning with water. I use soap and water. Speaker B: Download now! Start practicing!
